The '''Capacitive Armor''' was a lightweight protective [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that provided moderate defense against most types of attacks. It featured a costly, miniaturized power source that, when activated, caused its flexible panels to stiffen, increasing protection. However, this enhanced defense came at the cost of reduced mobility.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Capacitive Armor was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
